launch_jobs: submit a batch of RunConfig jobs to a Slurm executor via submitit with an rsync snapshot
override_config: recursively set a nested dot-separated key on a dataclass config object to a new value
fetch_config: recursively retrieve the value of a nested dot-separated key from a dataclass config object
main_runner_entry: run the Hydra-based entry point that expands variable sweeps into RunnerConfig jobs and launches them on Slurm
main_async: asynchronously expand RunnerConfig objects into RunConfigs, resolve OmegaConf interpolations, and submit jobs or print a dry-run summary
